title: Steering for CoT verbosity without harming faithfulness: a safety tradeoff probe

original_idea.body: Steer toward verbose CoT and measure faithfulness via a hint-injection test to see whether forced verbosity adds genuine or confabulated content.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: CoT monitorability is a recognized critical safety pathway; verbosity-vs-faithfulness tradeoff is decision-relevant.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Verbosity vector + hint-injection faithfulness test on a small reasoning model is guided; novice + mentor feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable but combines verbosity steering with a faithfulness intervention test.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: CoT faithfulness/monitorability is neglected, foundational safety work labs deprioritize; public model, no internal access.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference on a small reasoning model; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: The verbosity-steering-vs-faithfulness tradeoff appears largely unmeasured.
